## Status Rules

- **PASS** — verified by repository evidence or valid external evidence.
- **FIXED** — a repository issue was safely corrected and verified.
- **BLOCKED** — required evidence/approval is external or incomplete.
- **FAIL** — a verified requirement is currently broken.
- **N/A** — genuinely not applicable, with reason documented.

A gate must not be marked PASS merely because code or a configuration template exists.

## Security Final Gate

### Authentication / Authorization

- [x] Server-side authorization baseline reviewed.
- [x] Admin RBAC baseline reviewed.
- [x] JWT constant-time verification hardening present.
- [x] Session/revocation model present.
- [ ] Production identity source verified.
- [ ] Production secrets verified outside Git.

### Financial Security

- [x] Ledger is the source of truth by design.
- [x] Ledger corrections use compensating entries.
- [x] Balance locking is represented in withdrawal flow.
- [x] Idempotency keys/unique constraints are present in critical flows.
- [x] Webhook verification is designed to fail closed without the required secret.
- [ ] Concurrent reward/withdrawal/payout test evidence verified.
- [ ] Real-provider duplicate/retry behavior verified.

### Infrastructure

- [x] `.env*` excluded from Docker build context.
- [x] Production mock payout is guarded against.
- [ ] Production CORS configured with explicit origin.
- [ ] Cloudflare DNS/Tunnel/routing verified.
- [ ] Production PostgreSQL backup verified.
- [ ] Restore drill verified.
- [ ] DR drill verified.
- [ ] Monitoring/alerts/on-call verified.

## Legal / Business Gate

The audit does **not** certify legal or regulatory compliance.

Required external evidence:

- [ ] Privacy Policy approved and published.
- [ ] Terms of Service and reward/withdrawal rules approved and published.
- [ ] Applicable Indonesian legal/regulatory review completed.
- [ ] Tax review completed.
- [ ] Payment/payout classification reviewed.
- [ ] Provider contract/account approved.

If Regulatory Review is incomplete:

**STATUS = BLOCKED**  
**GO-LIVE = NO-GO**

## Production Decision

### Current decision

**BLOCKED / NO-GO**

Reason: required external production evidence is incomplete. The repository must not be treated as production-approved solely from source-code inspection.

### GO criteria

The release can move to **GO** only when every required gate above is backed by verifiable evidence, all critical security tests pass, production configuration is verified, real payout behavior is tested, and the legal/regulatory/provider gates are explicitly approved by the responsible parties.

## Audit Principle

Never convert an unknown or unverified production condition into PASS. When evidence is missing, retain **BLOCKED** or **NOT VERIFIED** until the responsible owner provides evidence.
